subject: Meter fix rollout + backfill request (streaming disconnect accounting) — Finance sign-off needed

body:
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Stone <emily.stone@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 5, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Meter fix rollout + backfill request (streaming disconnect accounting) — Finance sign-off needed

Hi Laura/Emily,

Quick engineering update on the streaming disconnect accounting defect and the proposed backfill window. We need Finance sign-off before we regenerate billing aggregates.

Summary
- Issue: we currently can over-count completion tokens in a narrow case where the client disconnects mid-stream and the server continues generating for a short time. Those post-disconnect tokens should not be billable.
- Fix: PR 41903 updates metering to stop billing after disconnect, while still capturing the partial usage that was actually delivered.
- Impact: backfill would reduce billed output tokens for a small subset of accounts (mostly high-volume streaming users). Based on a January sample, we expect invoice deltas to be negative (credits owed), not positive.

Proposed plan (target)
1) Deploy fix to prod: Fri 2/6 AM
2) Monitor 24h for regressions (telemetry completeness + billing hooks)
3) Backfill window: 2026-01-01 through 2026-02-04 (inclusive)
4) Generate audit artifacts: per-account delta report + query IDs + invoice_run_id references

Requested sign-off from Finance
- Please confirm we can proceed with the backfill window and whether Finance prefers:
  (a) apply credits on next invoice, or
  (b) issue corrected invoices for affected enterprise customers (we can do either, but (a) is operationally simpler).

Attachments:
- Backfill_Plan_StreamDisconnectFix_v1.2.pdf
- Estimated_Invoice_Impact_Summary_Feb2026.xlsx
- PR_41903_Test_Evidence_Screenshots.zip

Notes on controls/auditability
- We’ll stamp regenerated aggregates with a new invoice_run_id and meter_version (post-PR_41966 schema), and preserve the prior runs.
- We’ll keep the “before vs after” diffs at (account_id, day, model, region, endpoint) so Finance can trace to invoice line items.

If you can reply with “approved to backfill” (and preference for credit vs reissue) by EOD today, we can keep the Feb invoice cycle on track.

Thanks,
Ethan

—
Ethan Park
Control Plane Integration Lead
Redwood Inference


From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 5, 2026 at 10:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Meter fix rollout + backfill request (streaming disconnect accounting) — Finance sign-off needed

Thanks Ethan.

A few questions before we approve:
1) Are any Feb invoices already in “finalization” state where this would change totals after we’ve sent previews?
2) Can you quantify the expected max delta per account? (We need a threshold for escalation vs auto-credit.)
3) For the backfill, will the console usage page also update to match the regenerated aggregates, or will we create a temporary mismatch?

If you can answer those, I’m comfortable recommending we approve. Laura—FYI this likely leads to credits, not additional billings.

Emily

Emily Stone
Billing Controls & Close
Redwood Inference


From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 5, 2026 at 10:47 AM PST
Subject: Re: Meter fix rollout + backfill request (streaming disconnect accounting) — Finance sign-off needed

All good questions — answers inline.

1) Feb invoices / previews
- Self-serve: nothing “finalized” yet. Usage is still accumulating and we haven’t issued final invoices.
- Enterprise/Dedicated: the only previews already shared are for two accounts with month-to-date snapshots; we can flag that a correction may apply due to a metering fix. The delta should be small.

2) Expected max delta
- In the Jan reconciliation sample (n=63 accounts with streaming), median delta was ~0.00% (no impact) and 95th percentile was -0.8% of output tokens.
- Worst case in sample was -2.4% output tokens for one account with unusually high disconnect rate.
- In the attached XLSX tab “PerAcct_Est_Max”, we show conservative upper bounds by applying a 2.5% haircut to streaming output tokens for accounts above the 90th percentile of disconnects.

Proposed finance thresholds (suggestion)
- Auto-credit if impact < $5k OR < 1% of monthly invoice value
- Escalate to Finance + CS if >= $5k AND >= 1%

3) Console usage alignment
- Console usage page reads from the same billing-ready aggregates. Once backfill runs, console should move in lockstep (no long-lived mismatch).
- The only mismatch risk is a few hours during the backfill job while partitions are being rewritten. We plan to run in a “shadow” dataset first, then swap atomically.

Operational note
- We will suppress anomaly alerts during the backfill window to avoid SRE noise, but will still generate the delta dashboard output for Finance review.

Let me know if you want different thresholds.

Ethan


From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Stone <emily.stone@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 5, 2026 at 11:26 AM PST
Subject: Re: Meter fix rollout + backfill request (streaming disconnect accounting) — Finance sign-off needed

Adding FP&A lens:

- I agree this should be treated as credits (not reissuing invoices) unless a specific enterprise customer requires corrected invoices for procurement/audit reasons.
- Please ensure the delta report includes: total tokens delta, $ delta at effective rate (after discounts/credits), and which meter_version is applied.
- Also please confirm whether the fix changes COGS attribution in any way (I believe no — this is strictly “billable units” logic, but want to be sure).

If confirmed, I’m supportive of proceeding.

Rishi


From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Stone <emily.stone@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 5, 2026 at 12:04 PM PST
Subject: Re: Meter fix rollout + backfill request (streaming disconnect accounting) — Finance sign-off needed

Confirmed:
- Delta report will include both unit deltas and estimated $ deltas at the invoice effective rate (net of discounts where applicable). We’ll annotate the assumptions (self-serve list price vs enterprise contracted rates) clearly.
- meter_version: will bump to v3.1.7 for this change; the export will stamp the meter_version + invoice_run_id.
- COGS attribution: no change. GPU-time/cost modeling is unaffected; this is purely preventing billing for tokens generated after client disconnect.

If Laura approves, we’ll proceed per plan.

Ethan


From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Stone <emily.stone@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 5, 2026 at 1:18 PM PST
Subject: Re: Meter fix rollout + backfill request (streaming disconnect accounting) — Finance sign-off needed

Approved to proceed with the backfill for 2026-01-01 through 2026-02-04, contingent on:

1) Emily receives the per-account delta report before any customer-facing action.
2) Credits are the default remediation path; corrected invoices only by exception (loop in CS + Legal if needed).
3) If any single account delta is projected >$25k, pause and escalate to me before applying.

Please send a short status update after prod deploy tomorrow AM (go/no-go for the backfill run).

Laura

Laura Bennett
CFO
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Meter fix rollout + backfill request (streaming disconnect accounting) — Finance sign-off needed

Update: deployed PR 41903 to prod at 10:11 AM PST.

Health checks (last 4h)
- Metering event volume: stable vs baseline
- request_outcome distribution: unchanged
- No drop in streaming completion events
- Billing hook pipeline lag: within normal range

Go/No-go
- Go for backfill run. We’ll start the shadow backfill tonight 8 PM PST and plan to swap datasets Saturday morning if diffs look as expected.

Next deliverables
- Saturday: send Emily the per-account delta report + invoice_run_id references (before any credits are issued)
- Monday: summary note on total $ impact (high/medium/low) and any accounts meeting the escalation threshold

Ethan
